knowledge:
- key_parameters: nPatterns=The number of patterns (latent dimensions) to learn ;; nIterations=The number of MCMC iterations (default 50000, has the largest impact on runtime) ;; seed=Random seed for stochastic reproducibility ;; sparseOptimization=Logical, optimizes for sparse data (recommended for single-cell data) ;; distributed=Parallelization strategy (e.g., "genome-wide" to parallelize across sets) ;; nSets=Number of sets for distributed CoGAPS (configured via setDistributedParams) ;; threshold=In patternMarkers(), can be "all" (each gene assigned to exactly one pattern) or "cut" (genes sorted by intra-pattern rank, allows genes in multiple patterns) ;; axis=In patternMarkers(), 1 for feature/gene markers (default), 2 for sample markers
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation other than general Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) class algorithms.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for latent space learning, dimensionality reduction, and signature/process discovery in bulk or single-cell transcriptomics data.
- pitfalls: Stochastic nature of MCMC means results can vary unless seed is set ;; Long runtimes (several hours) on large datasets; users should immediately save the CogapsResult object using saveRDS or toCSV ;; Changing nPatterns requires calling setDistributedParams again if running distributed CoGAPS.

workflows.name: standard_cogaps_workflow
workflows.intent: Run standard sequential Bayesian NMF on a gene expression matrix to learn latent patterns.
input: modsimdata (matrix or data.frame of gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize parameters using new("CogapsParams") ;; 2. Modify parameters using setParam() ;; 3. Run factorization using CoGAPS() ;; 4. Extract sample factors and feature loadings from the CogapsResult object
workflows.code:
params <- new("CogapsParams", nPatterns=6)
params
getParam(params, "nPatterns")
params <- setParam(params, "nPatterns", 3)
getParam(params, "nPatterns")
cogapsresult <- CoGAPS(modsimdata, params, outputFrequency = 10000)
cogapsresult
cogapsresult@sampleFactors
cogapsresult@featureLoadings

workflows.name: distributed_sc_cogaps_workflow
workflows.intent: Run distributed CoGAPS on large single-cell transcriptomics data, identify pattern markers, perform gene set overrepresentation analysis, and run MANOVA on metadata.
input: interestedVariables (matrix/dataframe of metadata variables of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize parameters with sparse optimization and distributed settings using CogapsParams() ;; 2. Set distributed parameters using setDistributedParams() ;; 3. Run factorization using CoGAPS() ;; 4. Save results using saveRDS() or toCSV() ;; 5. Identify pattern markers using patternMarkers() ;; 6. Perform gene set overrepresentation analysis using getPatternGeneSet() ;; 7. Plot gene set enrichment results using plotPatternGeneSet() ;; 8. Run MANOVA on metadata variables using MANOVA()
workflows.code:
pdac_params <- CogapsParams(nIterations=50000, # 50000 iterations
               	seed=42, # for consistency across stochastic runs
               	nPatterns=8, # each thread will learn 8 patterns
                sparseOptimization=TRUE, # optimize for sparse data
                distributed="genome-wide") # parallelize across sets
pdac_params <- setDistributedParams(pdac_params, nSets=7)
pdac_epi_result <- CoGAPS(pdac_epi_counts, pdac_params)
saveRDS(pdac_epi_result, "../data/pdac_epi_cogaps_result.Rds")
toCSV(pdac_epi_result, "../data")
pm <- patternMarkers(cogapsresult)
hallmarks_ora <- getPatternGeneSet(cogapsresult,
                                   gene.sets = hallmark_ls,
                                   method = "overrepresentation")
pl_pattern7 <- plotPatternGeneSet(
  patterngeneset = hallmarks_ora, whichpattern = 7, padj_threshold = 0.05
)
interestedVariables <- cbind(pdac_data@meta.data[["nCount_RNA"]], pdac_data@meta.data[["nFeature_RNA"]])
manova_results <- MANOVA(interestedVariables, cogapsresult)
